subject: Error: Continuous variable () supplied to discrete scale_manual.

messages.author: 4549454b322c31e6
messages.subject: Error: Continuous variable () supplied to discrete scale_manual.
parts: What triggers this error message?  Is there any way to avoid it?

messages.author: e4aec126ff1dca22
messages.subject: Re: Error: Continuous variable () supplied to discrete scale_manual.
parts:
Hi Benjamin -

It means that you are specifying a continuous variable (e.g. numeric)
for something that it is expecting to be discrete (e.g. factor). If
you sent a small example we could help you out better.

Cheers
david.
